# Integrated Class Diagram

All the classes of the system, split by module so each diagram can be read. They come from the source code: a hollow triangle is inheritance (solid line) or interface implementation (dotted line), and an arrow means that the class keeps the other one in an attribute. Every class and its role is in the [class catalog](class-catalog.md); attributes and methods are in the [class reference](class-reference.md). A diagram shows up to five attributes and five methods per class.
